dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, indexed files, and shell parameter passing typical of ORCA system.
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE01PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) file creation for health insurance billing, part of the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system. Handles multiple insurance types including national health insurance (国保) and employee insurance (社保).
purpose.summary: This program creates receipt (レセプト) print files for medical insurance billing (医保). It reads multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE02, RECE031, RECE061, RECE09, RECE11), processes patient and insurance information, and generates output files for receipt printing. It is part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical practice management system.

notable_features: 37 COPY statements with REPLACING for copybook reuse
63 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
Multiple indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA medical receipt software. Source is fixed-format COBOL with some lines exceeding 72 columns (28 long lines) likely due to comments or string literals. No COMP-3 usage is notable for a financial/billing program.
